# Repository instructions

The sole authoritative source for all ParandO product, architecture, engineering, security, workflow, and delivery requirements is [`docs/PARANDO_CANONICAL_SPEC.md`](../docs/PARANDO_CANONICAL_SPEC.md).

Read and follow that document before every task. Do not duplicate, summarize, reinterpret, or create competing project rules or specifications in other files. If a genuine ambiguity or conflict exists, identify the exact section and ask the owner rather than inventing a requirement.

Owner-facing reports and operational instructions must be written in clear Persian.
